WITH 
  pedidos_validos AS (
    SELECT 
      order_id, 
      AVG(review_score) AS calificacion, 
      julianday(order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(order_estimated_delivery_date) AS dias_retraso 
    FROM 
      vw_pedidos_validos 
    JOIN 
      order_reviews ON vw_pedidos_validos.order_id = order_reviews.order_id 
    GROUP BY 
      order_id 
  ),
  pedidos_retraso AS (
    SELECT 
      dias_retraso, 
      calificacion, 
      COUNT(*) AS num_pedidos 
    FROM 
      pedidos_validos 
    GROUP BY 
      dias_retraso 
  ),
  pedidos_atiempo AS (
    SELECT 
      COUNT(*) AS num_pedidos 
    FROM 
      pedidos_retraso 
    WHERE 
      dias_retraso <= 0 
  ),
  pedidos_retraso_2_o_menos AS (
    SELECT 
      dias_retraso, 
      COUNT(*) AS num_pedidos 
    FROM 
      pedidos_retraso 
    WHERE 
      calificacion <= 2 
    GROUP BY 
      dias_retraso 
  )

    WHEN dias_retraso <= 7 THEN '4-7 días' 
    WHEN dias_retraso <= 14 THEN '8-14 días' 
    ELSE '15+ días' 
  END AS rango, 
  num_pedidos, 
  ROUND
